title: FAITHFULNESS: PhlimboV3 'the flush must never brick' invariant undermined by unchecked abi.decode (story-022)
description: story-022 + SolvencyDetermination.md §4 document that failed transfers are banked into unclaimablePromo so 'the flush must never brick.' The banking design is faithful for a compliant failing transfer, but the non-reverting primitive _tryTransfer (L816-820) does abi.decode(returndata,(bool)) with no length check; a token returning non-empty return-data shorter than 32 bytes makes abi.decode revert, propagating out and reverting the batchClaim chunk — bricking the very flush the invariant protects.
impact: Documented invariant does not fully hold. Standalone Low (faithfulness / invariant-violation). Security impact owned by L-02 (no double-count). Owner-vetted promo tokens keep likelihood low.
recommendation: Gate the decode on returndata.length >= 32 (else return false) so the flush is non-bricking for any transfer-return shape.
securityCrossRef: L-02 (V3-L-02, DEDUP-06) — owns the DoS severity.
